# Pantry Ledger

Pantry Ledger is a small local service for a community pantry. The initial
scaffold exposes only a health endpoint; inventory behavior will be shaped and
built during the AI SDLC lifecycle simulation.

## Requirements

- Node.js 22 or newer

## Run

```bash
npm test
npm start
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:3000/health`.
